game.description: detected game facts; heartbeat before the first READY: null

BuildingDto.description: Full building detail (player buildings, and AI buildings when buildings_ai_detail is enabled).

consistent.description: true when every section was read on the same game day

paid_to_build_total.description: sum of paid_to_build over the company's buildings

GameInfoDto.description: Game build facts. In envelopes these are the detected values of the running game.

assembly_sha256.description: SHA-256 (upper-case hex) of the loaded Assembly-CSharp.dll; null until computed

inbound_cap.description: Max Send stored on this building for this product; 0 = unlimited

headroom_now.description: R: max(value - (stock + incoming_reserved), 0); null when unlimited

building_costs.description: Current build price per building type from the player's tech tree (the value TechTreeAgent.GetBuildingCost returns, before regional modifiers); null when the price table could not be read

RegionValueInputDto.description: Inputs for the company value replica D-VAL-1, per region whose full permit the company owns.

route_key.description: origin|product|destination|source|n (route id without the route: prefix)

StateData.description: state.json data (PRD 12.2). Each section is null when its envelope section status is not ok.

instance_id.description: GetInstanceID of the pooled vehicle object (world-session scoped)

trip_counter_id.description: Vehicle.id: reassigned per trip, wraps at 65535; not an identity

identity.description: session_pooled_object: vehicle ids are only valid in this world session
